description: This is a Java test class for the RecordHistoryKeyboardActionListener, testing its interaction with the OnKeyboardActionListener and HistoryQuickTextKey classes using Mockito and JUnit.

classes.name: RecordHistoryKeyboardActionListenerTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for RecordHistoryKeyboardActionListener, testing method interactions and behavior.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes mock objects and the class under test before each test method.

methods.name: testDispatchToListener
methods.description: Verifies that the RecordHistoryKeyboardActionListener correctly delegates actions to the OnKeyboardActionListener.

methods.name: onTextWithNoLabel
methods.description: Tests onText method when the key label is null; verifies that onText is called and no interaction with HistoryQuickTextKey.

methods.name: onTextWithNoText
methods.description: Tests onText method when the text argument is null; verifies that onText is called and no interaction with HistoryQuickTextKey.

methods.name: onTextWithText
methods.description: Tests onText method when the text argument is provided; verifies that onText is called and recordUsedKey is invoked on HistoryQuickTextKey.
